drivingQuestion: Why does the mishna state the Torah-level tool after the rabbinic-level one?

segments.he: הַשְׁתָּא מִשּׁוּם שְׁבוּת אָמְרַתְּ לָא — לֹא תַעֲשֶׂה מִיבַּעְיָא? זוֹ וְאֵין צָרִיךְ לוֹמַר זוֹ קָתָנֵי.
segments.en: The Gemara asks: «Now» that «you have said» that to sound the shofar «one may not» perform an action that is prohibited «due to rabbinic law, is» it «necessary» to say that one may not perform an action that violates «a prohibition» by Torah law? The Gemara answers: The mishna «teaches» employing the style: «This, and it is unnecessary to say that.»

moves.about: having ruled out a rabbinic-level tool, the Torah-level tool is superfluous
